correctness.rationale: The base signed clique sector decomposition B_p=positive unit cube plus p disjoint one-negative sectors has volume 2, and independently integrated beta moments reproduce μ,c_perp,c_parallel. Fiber at T=min Y is T B_p; T has Beta(p+1,q), giving volume 2p!q!/n! and conditional covariance decomposition into transverse eigenspaces and 2x2 longitudinal M_pq. Independent exact rational computations matched 121 parameter pairs. In proportional scaling the longitudinal matrix G=diag(a²,b²)+3ab vv^T has trace 1+ab, det 4a²b², largest eigenvalue Λ_+(ab)≥v^TGv=1; smallest whole-covariance eigenvalue is min(a²,b²)/12. Hence limiting ratio ≥4, equality iff a=b=1/2. A transverse eigenvalue collapses in either extreme regime, proving divergence and the iff sequence claim by compactness. The assertion is coordinate-Euclidean asymptotic, not affine invariant or finite-n ≥4.
